# Prometheus rules: alerts about the observability stack and host.
# Generated by Raion. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next "raion apply".
# To change it, edit your workspace files and run "raion plan".
groups:
  - name: raion-platform
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - alert: Watchdog
        expr: vector(1)
        labels:
          severity: none
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: The alerting pipeline is working
          description: This alert always fires. Raion checks that it reaches Alertmanager; if it stops arriving, alerts are not being evaluated or delivered.
      - alert: RaionComponentDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.job }} is down or cannot be monitored"
          description: Prometheus has not been able to reach {{ $labels.job }} for 2 minutes. Telemetry handled by it may be lost. Run "raion status".
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionTelemetryRefused
        expr: ((sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_spans[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records[5m])) or vector(0))) > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: The collector refused {{ $value | humanize }} telemetry items in 5 minutes
          description: Applications are sending more than the collector can accept (memory limit) or sending malformed data. The applications retry, but data can be lost.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionTelemetryNotDelivered
        expr: ((sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records[5m])) or vector(0))) > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: The collector could not deliver {{ $value | humanize }} items to storage
          description: Prometheus, Loki or Tempo is rejecting or not answering the collector. Telemetry is being lost. Run "raion status".
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionCollectorQueueNearlyFull
        expr: max by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size / otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity) > 0.8
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: Collector queue for {{ $labels.exporter }} is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} full
          description: Storage is not keeping up with incoming telemetry. When the queue is full, new data is dropped.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionRuleEvaluationFailing
        expr: sum(increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total[10m])) > 0
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: Prometheus failed to evaluate some rules
          description: Alerts depending on those rules cannot fire. This usually indicates a bug; please report it with "raion status" output.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionNotificationsFailing
        expr: sum by (integration) (increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[15m])) > 0
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: Alert notifications via {{ $labels.integration }} are failing
          description: Alertmanager could not deliver notifications. Check the receiver settings and secrets (raion secrets list). Alerts are still visible in the Raion inbox.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-stack-health
      - alert: RaionAlertmanagerUnreachable
        expr: max(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered) < 1
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          raion_scope: platform
        annotations:
          summary: Prometheus cannot send alerts to Alertmanager
          description: Alerts are evaluated but not delivered. Run "raion status".
  - name: raion-infrastructure
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - alert: HostDiskAlmostFull
        expr: (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|9p|fuse.*|rootfs|autofs|ramfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|9p|fuse.*|rootfs|autofs|ramfs"}) > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          raion_scope: infrastructure
        annotations:
          summary: Disk {{ $labels.device }} is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} full
          description: A filesystem on the host is over 90% full. When it is full, storage components (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo) and your services stop working. Free space or lower retention in raion.yaml.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-infrastructure
      - alert: HostDiskWillFillIn24Hours
        expr: (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|9p|fuse.*|rootfs|autofs|ramfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|9p|fuse.*|rootfs|autofs|ramfs"}) > 0.7 and predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|9p|fuse.*|rootfs|autofs|ramfs"}[6h], 24 * 3600) < 0
        for: 30m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: infrastructure
        annotations:
          summary: Disk {{ $labels.device }} will be full within 24 hours at the current rate
          description: Based on the last 6 hours, this filesystem runs out of space within a day.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-infrastructure
      - alert: HostMemoryPressure
        expr: sum(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) < 0.1
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: infrastructure
        annotations:
          summary: Only {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of memory is available
          description: The host is close to running out of memory; processes may be killed. Look for the process using the most memory.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-infrastructure
      - alert: HostHighCpu
        expr: 1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) > 0.9
        for: 15m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          raion_scope: infrastructure
        annotations:
          summary: CPU has been {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} busy for 15 minutes
          description: Sustained high CPU slows everything on the host, including request handling.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-infrastructure
